title: New Britain Youth Museum At Hungerford Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: ​​The New Britain Youth Museum is no longer operating as a standalone location. We’ve grown and transitioned into something even bigger....as a part of Hungerford Nature Center in Berlin, CT! Head on over to their website to stay updated about all upcoming information.

quotes.text: ​​The New Britain Youth Museum is no longer operating as a standalone location. We’ve grown and transitioned into something even bigger....as a part of Hungerford Nature Center in Berlin, CT! Head on over to their website to stay updated about all upcoming information. In the meantime follow Hungerford's social media to be updated about any programs and news about the revovation.
